# Project description

In this project we extracted the DNA of bulk soil without removing the roots (BR), bulk soil removing the roots (BS), rhizosphere (Rh), stolon endosphere (stolon), leaf endosphere (leaf), below ground leaf/stem (BG), stolonosphere (SP) of some endemic plants in the páramo Chingaza:

- Espeletia (BR, BS, Rh, stolon, leaf, BG, SP)
- Chusquea (BR, BS, Rh, root)
- Oritrophium (BR, BS, Rh, stolon)
- Racomitrium (BR, BS, AG, BG)
- Calamagrostis (root, Rh)
- Oreobolus (root, Rh)

Here we performed the ITS data analysis for fungal communities.

## ITS amplicons data analysis

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate qiime2-amplicon-2024.10
```

# QIIME2

### Read and filter metadata

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv("~/Documents/CouradeauLab/paramos/Rhizosphere/Amplicons/ITS/metadata.csv") %>%
  select(-forward.absolute.filepath, -reverse.absolute.filepath) %>%
  unite("Host_Part", Host_species:Shortened_description, remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Ecosite = case_when(
      Host_species == "Espeletia"     ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oritrophium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Racomitrium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Calamagrostis" ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Chusquea"      ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oreobolus"     ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Broad_Compartment_fine = case_when(
      Shortened_description == "BS"                          ~ "A_Bulk_Soil",
      Shortened_description == "BR"                          ~ "B_Root_Affected_Soil",
      Shortened_description %in% c("Rh", "SP")              ~ "C_Rhizosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("root", "stolon", "BG")  ~ "D_Endosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("leaf", "AG")            ~ "E_Aboveground",
      TRUE ~ Shortened_description
    ),
    Broad_Compartment_fine = factor(Broad_Compartment_fine,
      levels = c("A_Bulk_Soil", "B_Root_Affected_Soil", "C_Rhizosphere",
                 "D_Endosphere", "E_Aboveground")),
    Broad_Compartment = case_when(
      Shortened_description %in% c("BS", "BR")              ~ "Bulk_Soil",
      Shortened_description %in% c("Rh", "SP")              ~ "Rhizosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("root", "stolon", "BG")  ~ "Endosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("leaf", "AG")            ~ "Aboveground",
      TRUE ~ Shortened_description
    ),
    Broad_Compartment = factor(Broad_Compartment,
      levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere", "Aboveground"))
  )

write_tsv(metadata, "ITS/metadata_updated.tsv")

metadata_all <- read.csv("~/Documents/CouradeauLab/paramos/Rhizosphere/Amplicons/ITS/metadata.csv") %>%
  select(-forward.absolute.filepath, -reverse.absolute.filepath) %>%
  unite("Host_Part", Host_species:Shortened_description, remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Ecosite = case_when(
      Host_species == "Espeletia"     ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oritrophium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Racomitrium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Calamagrostis" ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Chusquea"      ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oreobolus"     ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Compartment_ = case_when(
      Shortened_description %in% c("BS", "BR")      ~ "Soil",
      Shortened_description == "Rh"                 ~ "Rhizosphere",
      Shortened_description == "SP"                  ~ "Stolonosphere",
      Shortened_description == "root"                 ~ "Endosphere",
      Shortened_description == "stolon"              ~ "StolonEndosphere",
      Shortened_description == "BG"              ~ "BelowGroundStem",
      Shortened_description == "leaf"              ~ "Leaf",
      Shortened_description == "AG"              ~ "Aboveground",
      TRUE ~ Shortened_description
    ))

write_tsv(metadata_all, "ITS/metadata_ALL_updated.tsv")
```

### Import data and demultiplex sequences (QIIME2)

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime tools import \
  --type 'SampleData[PairedEndSequencesWithQuality]' \
  --input-path ITS/metadata.csv \
  --output-path ITS/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qza \
  --input-format PairedEndFastqManifestPhred33V2

qiime demux summarize \
  --i-data ITS/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qza \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qzv

qiime metadata tabulate \
  --m-input-file ITS/metadata.tsv \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/metadata.qzv
```

### Quality control and feature table

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime dada2 denoise-paired \
  --i-demultiplexed-seqs ITS/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qza \
  --p-trunc-len-f 208 \
  --p-trunc-len-r 209 \
  --p-trim-left-f 36 \
  --p-trim-left-r 36 \
  --p-n-threads 0 \
  --p-chimera-method pooled \
  --o-table ITS/qiime2output/table.qza \
  --o-representative-sequences ITS/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qza \
  --o-denoising-stats ITS/qiime2output/denoising-stats.qza
```

### Generate summaries

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime feature-table summarize \
  --i-table ITS/qiime2output/table.qza \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/table.qzv \
  --m-sample-metadata-file ITS/metadata.tsv

qiime feature-table tabulate-seqs \
  --i-data ITS/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qza \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qzv

qiime metadata tabulate \
  --m-input-file ITS/qiime2output/denoising-stats.qza \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/denoising-stats.qzv
```

### Taxonomy classification

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime feature-classifier classify-sklearn \
  --i-classifier ITS/unite_ver10_99_19.02.2025-Q2-2024.10.qza \
  --i-reads ITS/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qza \
  --o-classification ITS/qiime2output/taxonomy.qza

qiime metadata tabulate \
  --m-input-file ITS/qiime2output/taxonomy.qza \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/taxonomy.qzv

qiime taxa barplot \
  --i-table ITS/qiime2output/table.qza \
  --i-taxonomy ITS/qiime2output/taxonomy.qza \
  --m-metadata-file ITS/metadata.tsv \
  --o-visualization ITS/qiime2output/taxa-bar-plots.qzv
```

### Note on phylogenetic tree

ITS alignments are not reliable for informing evolutionary distances among distantly related fungal taxa. We therefore avoid UniFrac-based metrics and use Bray-Curtis dissimilarity for all beta diversity analyses.

## Import into R

```{r, message=FALSE}
physeq <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features = "ITS/qiime2output/table.qza",
  taxonomy = "ITS/qiime2output/taxonomy.qza",
  metadata = "ITS/metadata_updated.tsv"
)
physeq

sort(sample_sums(physeq))[1:10]

read_depth <- sample_sums(physeq)
ggplot(data.frame(Reads = read_depth), aes(x = Reads)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2000, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(read_depth), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Read Depth Distribution (ITS)", x = "Number of Reads", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

ALL_physeq <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features = "ITS/qiime2output/table.qza",
  taxonomy = "ITS/qiime2output/taxonomy.qza",
  metadata = "ITS/metadata_ALL_updated.tsv"
)
ALL_physeq
```

## Filter non-fungal taxa and low-depth samples

ITS does not have chloroplast/mitochondria contamination, but may contain non-fungal ASVs.

```{r}
cat("ASVs before filtering:", ntaxa(physeq), "\n")

physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(physeq,
  !is.na(Kingdom) & grepl("Fungi", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat("ASVs after keeping only Fungi:", ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "\n")

cat("\nLowest depth samples after filtering:\n")
low_depth <- sort(sample_sums(physeq_filtered))[1:10]
print(low_depth)

low_samples <- names(low_depth[low_depth < 1000])
if (length(low_samples) > 0) {
  cat("\nDropping", length(low_samples), "samples with <1000 fungal reads:\n")
  sd_low <- as(sample_data(physeq_filtered), "data.frame")[low_samples,
    c("Host_species", "Shortened_description", "Broad_Compartment")]
  print(sd_low)
  physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_filtered) >= 1000, physeq_filtered)
}

# Drop samples below 15,000 reads
physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_filtered) >= 15000, physeq_filtered)
cat("\nFinal dataset:", ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "ASVs,", nsamples(physeq_filtered), "samples\n")
cat("Min depth:", min(sample_sums(physeq_filtered)), "\n")

## ALL host parts
cat("ASVs before filtering:", ntaxa(ALL_physeq), "\n")

ALL_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(ALL_physeq,
  !is.na(Kingdom) & grepl("Fungi", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat("ASVs after keeping only Fungi:", ntaxa(ALL_physeq_filtered), "\n")

cat("\nLowest depth samples after filtering:\n")
low_depth <- sort(sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered))[1:10]
print(low_depth)

low_samples <- names(low_depth[low_depth < 1000])
if (length(low_samples) > 0) {
  cat("\nDropping", length(low_samples), "samples with <1000 fungal reads:\n")
  sd_low <- as(sample_data(ALL_physeq_filtered), "data.frame")[low_samples,
    c("Host_species", "Shortened_description", "Broad_Compartment")]
  print(sd_low)
  ALL_physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered) >= 1000, ALL_physeq_filtered)
}

# Drop samples below 15,000 reads
ALL_physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered) >= 15000, ALL_physeq_filtered)
cat("\nFinal dataset:", ntaxa(ALL_physeq_filtered), "ASVs,", nsamples(ALL_physeq_filtered), "samples\n")
cat("Min depth:", min(sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered)), "\n")
```

## Rarefaction curves

```{r rarefaction, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
rare_depth <- min(sample_sums(physeq_filtered))
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(physeq_filtered), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_filtered)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

set.seed(42)
rare_data <- rarecurve(otu_mat, step = 500, tidy = TRUE)

sd_df <- as(sample_data(physeq_filtered), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("Site")
rare_df <- rare_data %>%
  left_join(sd_df, by = "Site")

#ALL host parts
set.seed(42)
ALL_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(
  prune_samples(sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered) >= 10000, ALL_physeq_filtered),
  sample.size = min(sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered)[sample_sums(ALL_physeq_filtered) >= 10000]),
  replace = FALSE, rngseed = 42
)

ggplot(rare_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site, color = Broad_Compartment)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rare_depth, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  labs(title = "Rarefaction Curves (ITS) — By Compartment",
       x = "Sequencing Depth", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(rare_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site, color = Host_species)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rare_depth, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = host_pal) +
  labs(title = "Rarefaction Curves (ITS) — By Host Species",
       x = "Sequencing Depth", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Core microbiome — Fine compartments (before merging)

Justify merging BS + BR for fungi as we did for bacteria.

## Core ASVs: fine compartments

```{r}
find_core <- function(ps, comp_name, comp_col = "Broad_Compartment_fine", prev_threshold = 0.5) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  keep_samples <- rownames(sd)[sd[[comp_col]] == comp_name]
  sub_ps <- prune_samples(keep_samples, ps)
  sub_ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sub_ps) > 0, sub_ps)
  otu <- as(otu_table(sub_ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(sub_ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  prevalence <- rowSums(otu > 0) / ncol(otu)
  return(names(prevalence[prevalence >= prev_threshold]))
}

fine_compartments <- c("A_Bulk_Soil", "B_Root_Affected_Soil", "C_Rhizosphere", "D_Endosphere")
core_fine <- setNames(
  lapply(fine_compartments, function(comp) find_core(physeq_filtered, comp, "Broad_Compartment_fine")),
  fine_compartments
)

cat("Core fungal ASVs per fine compartment (≥50% prevalence):\n")
sapply(core_fine, length)
```

## UpSet plot — Fine compartments (BS vs BR justification)

```{r}
upset(fromList(core_fine),
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = 4,
      sets.bar.color = unname(compartment_fine_pal[names(core_fine)]),
      main.bar.color = "grey30",
      text.scale = 1.3,
      point.size = 3,
      line.size = 1.2,
      mainbar.y.label = "Number of Shared Core ASVs",
      sets.x.label = "Core ASVs per Compartment")
```

## PERMANOVA: BS vs BR justification

```{r}
ps_bs_br <- subset_samples(physeq_filtered,
  Broad_Compartment_fine %in% c("A_Bulk_Soil", "B_Root_Affected_Soil"))
ps_bs_br <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_bs_br) > 0, ps_bs_br)

bray_bs_br <- phyloseq::distance(ps_bs_br, "bray")
meta_bs_br <- as(sample_data(ps_bs_br), "data.frame")

adonis2(bray_bs_br ~ Broad_Compartment_fine, data = meta_bs_br, permutations = 999)
```

# Who is there — Taxonomic composition

All downstream analysis uses the merged compartments: Bulk_Soil, Rhizosphere, Endosphere, Aboveground.

## Phylum level

```{r, warning=FALSE}
physeq_phylum_rel <- physeq_filtered %>%
  tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

plot_bar(physeq_phylum_rel, x = "Sample", fill = "Phylum") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(Ecosite ~ Host_species + Shortened_description,
             scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_pal) +
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

top_phyla <- psmelt(physeq_phylum_rel) %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

top_pal <- setNames(
  c(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"), "black"),
  c(sort(top_phyla), "Other")
)

df_top <- psmelt(physeq_phylum_rel) %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = ifelse(Phylum %in% top_phyla, Phylum, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Phylum_grouped, Ecosite, Host_species, Shortened_description) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = factor(Phylum_grouped, levels = c(sort(top_phyla), "Other")))

ggplot(df_top, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(Ecosite ~ Host_species + Shortened_description,
             scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = top_pal, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(title = "Top Phyla + Other (ITS)", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
```

### Phylum composition per host per part

```{r}
#ALL host parts
ps_phy_fine <- ALL_physeq_filtered %>%
  tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

df_fine <- psmelt(ps_phy_fine) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Compartment_)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = ifelse(Phylum %in% top_phyla, Phylum, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Host_species, Compartment_, Phylum_grouped) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Host_species, Compartment_) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = factor(Phylum_grouped, levels = c(sort(top_phyla), "Other")))

ggplot(df_fine, aes(Sample, RelAbundance, fill = Phylum_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(Host_species ~ Compartment_, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = top_pal, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Phyla — Host × Fine Compartment",
       x = "", y = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
```

### Soils only

```{r}
# ── Soil-only composition: all soil samples pooled, one bar per sample ─────
ps_soil <- subset_samples(ALL_physeq_filtered, Compartment_ == "Soil")
ps_soil <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_soil) > 0, ps_soil)

ps_soil_phy <- ps_soil %>%
  tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

df_soil <- psmelt(ps_soil_phy) %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = ifelse(Phylum %in% top_phyla, Phylum, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Host_species, Phylum_grouped) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = factor(Phylum_grouped,
                                  levels = c(sort(top_phyla), "Other")))

# Order samples by host species so host-related structure is visible
sample_order <- df_soil %>%
  distinct(Sample, Host_species) %>%
  arrange(Host_species, Sample) %>%
  pull(Sample)
df_soil <- df_soil %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order))

ggplot(df_soil,
       aes(x = Sample, y = RelAbundance, fill = Phylum_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Host_species, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = top_pal, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(title = "ITS Fungal Phylum Composition — Soil (BS + BR pooled across hosts)",
       subtitle = paste0(nsamples(ps_soil), " soil samples"),
       x = "", y = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave("ITS_figures/ITS_phylum_soil_only.pdf",
       width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
physeq_genus <- tax_glom(physeq_filtered, "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
physeq_genus_rel <- transform_sample_counts(physeq_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))

top50_genera <- names(sort(taxa_sums(physeq_genus_rel), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]

)

mat_genus <- as(otu_table(physeq_top50), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_top50)) mat_genus <- t(mat_genus)
rownames(mat_genus) <- tax_top50$label

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Compartment = sample_data(physeq_top50)$Broad_Compartment,
  Host = sample_data(physeq_top50)$Host_species,
  Ecosite = sample_data(physeq_top50)$Ecosite,
  row.names = sample_names(physeq_top50)
)

sample_order <- rownames(annotation_col)[order(annotation_col$Compartment, annotation_col$Host)]
mat_genus <- mat_genus[, sample_order]
annotation_col <- annotation_col[sample_order, ]
comp_gaps <- cumsum(table(annotation_col$Compartment))

ann_colors <- list(

  Host = host_pal,
  Ecosite = ecosite_pal
)

# Check to determine color scale

summary(as.vector(mat_scaled))
range(mat_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)

color_breaks <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101)

pheatmap(mat_genus,
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         gaps_col = comp_gaps,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         fontsize_row = 7,
         main = "Top 50 Fungal Genera (Ordered by Compartment × Host)",
```

# Alpha diversity

Calculated at ASV level. No phylogenetic metrics for ITS.

```{r}
set.seed(42)
min_depth <- min(sample_sums(physeq_filtered))
cat("Rarefying to:", min_depth, "reads\n")

physeq_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(physeq_filtered, sample.size = min_depth,
                                  replace = FALSE, rngseed = 42)

alpha_div <- estimate_richness(physeq_rare, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed", "Chao1"))
alpha_div$Sample <- rownames(alpha_div)
alpha_meta <- cbind(alpha_div, as(sample_data(physeq_rare), "data.frame"))
```

### Shannon and richness along gradient

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(alpha_meta, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = Shannon, fill = Broad_Compartment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  labs(title = "Shannon Diversity (ITS)", x = "", y = "Shannon Index") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(alpha_meta, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = Observed, fill = Broad_Compartment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  labs(title = "ASV Richness (ITS)", x = "", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

p1 + p2
```

## PERMANOVA

```{r}
meta_df <- as(sample_data(physeq_rare), "data.frame")
bray_rare <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_rare, "bray")

cat("=== PERMANOVA: Broad_Compartment ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Broad_Compartment, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Host_species ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Host_species, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Ecosite ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Ecosite, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Full Model ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Broad_Compartment + Host_species + Ecosite,
        data = meta_df, permutations = 999, by = "terms")

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Compartment × Host Interaction ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Broad_Compartment * Host_species,
        data = meta_df, permutations = 999, by = "terms")
```

### Pairwise PERMANOVA

```{r}
compartments <- unique(as.character(meta_df$Broad_Compartment))
compartments <- compartments[!is.na(compartments) & compartments != ""]
n_comp <- length(compartments)

pairwise_results <- data.frame(
  Comp1 = character(), Comp2 = character(),
  R2 = numeric(), p_value = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in 1:(n_comp - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):n_comp) {
    sub_samples <- rownames(meta_df)[meta_df$Broad_Compartment %in%
                                       c(compartments[i], compartments[j])]
    n_per_group <- table(meta_df[sub_samples, "Broad_Compartment"])
    n_per_group <- n_per_group[n_per_group > 0]
    if (length(n_per_group) < 2 || any(n_per_group < 2)) {
      cat("Skipping", compartments[i], "vs", compartments[j], "- insufficient samples\n")
      next
    }
    sub_physeq <- prune_samples(sub_samples, physeq_rare)
    sub_physeq <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sub_physeq) > 0, sub_physeq)
    sub_dist <- phyloseq::distance(sub_physeq, "bray")
    sub_meta <- as(sample_data(sub_physeq), "data.frame")
    res <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ Broad_Compartment, data = sub_meta, permutations = 999)
    pairwise_results <- rbind(pairwise_results, data.frame(
      Comp1 = compartments[i], Comp2 = compartments[j],
      R2 = res$R2[1], p_value = res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
    ))
  }
}

pairwise_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value, method = "BH")
knitr::kable(pairwise_results, digits = 4,
             caption = "Pairwise PERMANOVA (ITS): Compartment Comparisons")
```

## Constrained ordination (dbRDA)

```{r}
bray_all <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_filtered, "bray")
meta_all <- as(sample_data(physeq_filtered), "data.frame")

cap <- capscale(bray_all ~ Broad_Compartment + Host_species, data = meta_all)
cat("=== ANOVA on dbRDA (ITS) ===\n")
anova(cap, by = "terms")

site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cap, display = "sites"))
site_scores <- cbind(site_scores, meta_all)
bp_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cap, display = "bp"))

ITSdbRDA <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, color = Broad_Compartment, shape = Host_species),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  geom_segment(data = bp_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1 * 0.9, yend = CAP2 * 0.9),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(data = bp_scores,
                  aes(x = CAP1 * 0.95, y = CAP2 * 0.95,
                      label = rownames(bp_scores)), color = "black", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "dbRDA (ITS): Compartment + Host Species",
       x = paste0("CAP1 (", round(100 * cap$CCA$eig[1] / sum(cap$CCA$eig), 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("CAP2 (", round(100 * cap$CCA$eig[2] / sum(cap$CCA$eig), 1), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("ITS_figures/ITSdbRDA.pdf", ITSdbRDA, width = 10, height = 8)
```

### Core genera

```{r}
physeq_genus_filt <- tax_glom(physeq_filtered, "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

find_core_genus <- function(ps, comp_name, comp_col = "Broad_Compartment", prev_threshold = 0.5) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  keep_samples <- rownames(sd)[sd[[comp_col]] == comp_name]
  sub_ps <- prune_samples(keep_samples, ps)
  sub_ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sub_ps) > 0, sub_ps)
  otu <- as(otu_table(sub_ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(sub_ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  prevalence <- rowSums(otu > 0) / ncol(otu)
  core_otus <- names(prevalence[prevalence >= prev_threshold])
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(sub_ps))
  genus_names <- tax[core_otus, "Genus"]
  genus_names[is.na(genus_names)] <- paste0("Unc.", tax[core_otus[is.na(genus_names)], "Family"])
  return(setNames(core_otus, genus_names))
}

core_genus_merged <- setNames(
  lapply(merged_compartments, function(comp) find_core_genus(physeq_genus_filt, comp)),
  merged_compartments
)

genus_name_lists <- lapply(core_genus_merged, names)
cat("Core fungal genera per compartment:\n")
sapply(genus_name_lists, length)

upset(fromList(genus_name_lists),
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = 4,
      sets.bar.color = unname(compartment_pal[names(genus_name_lists)]),
      main.bar.color = "grey30",
      text.scale = 1.3,
      mainbar.y.label = "Shared Core Genera",
      sets.x.label = "Core Genera per Compartment")
```

# Differential abundance — ANCOM-BC2

## Helper functions

```{r}
# Clean genus labels — handles uncultured/unidentified
add_genus_labels <- function(ps) {
  tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>% rownames_to_column("taxon")
  tax_df$Genus_label <- case_when(
    !is.na(tax_df$Genus) & tax_df$Genus != "" &
      !grepl("uncultured|unidentified", tax_df$Genus, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ tax_df$Genus,
    !is.na(tax_df$Family) & tax_df$Family != "" &
      !grepl("uncultured|unidentified", tax_df$Family, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Family),
    !is.na(tax_df$Order) & tax_df$Order != "" &
      !grepl("uncultured|unidentified", tax_df$Order, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Order),
    !is.na(tax_df$Class) & tax_df$Class != "" &
      !grepl("uncultured|unidentified", tax_df$Class, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Class),
    !is.na(tax_df$Phylum) & tax_df$Phylum != ""
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Phylum),
    TRUE ~ paste0("Unc.taxon_", tax_df$taxon)
  )
  return(tax_df)
}

# Column finder — excludes robust columns
get_ancom_cols <- function(df, pattern) {
  lfc  <- grep(paste0("^lfc_.*", pattern, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  q    <- grep(paste0("^q_.*", pattern, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  diff <- grep(paste0("^diff_.*", pattern, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  diff <- diff[!grepl("robust", diff)]
  cat("Pattern:", pattern, "-> lfc:", lfc, "| q:", q, "| diff:", diff, "\n")
  list(lfc = lfc, q = q, diff = diff)
}

# Volcano plot
make_ancom_volcano <- function(df, lfc_col, q_col, title_str, lfc_cut = 1) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    rename(lfc = all_of(lfc_col), q_val = all_of(q_col)) %>%
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
      q_val < 0.05 & lfc > lfc_cut  ~ "Enriched",
      q_val < 0.05 & lfc < -lfc_cut ~ "Depleted",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ))
  top_labels <- plot_df %>% filter(Significance != "NS") %>% arrange(q_val) %>% head(15)
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lfc, y = -log10(q_val), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "firebrick", "Depleted" = "steelblue", "NS" = "grey70")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_labels, aes(label = Genus_label),
                    size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20, color = "black") +
    labs(title = title_str, x = "log Fold Change", y = "-log10(q-value)") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Top bar plot
make_top_bar <- function(df, lfc_col, q_col, diff_col, comp_name, n = 20) {
  top_df <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[diff_col]] == TRUE) %>%
    rename(lfc = all_of(lfc_col), q_val = all_of(q_col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>%
    head(n) %>%
    mutate(Direction = ifelse(lfc > 0, paste0("Enriched in ", comp_name),
                                        paste0("Depleted in ", comp_name)))
  ggplot(top_df, aes(x = reorder(Genus_label, lfc), y = lfc, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("firebrick", "steelblue"),
      c(paste0("Enriched in ", comp_name), paste0("Depleted in ", comp_name)))) +
    labs(title = comp_name, x = "", y = "log Fold Change") +
    # labs(title = paste(comp_name, "vs Bulk Soil"), x = "", y = "log Fold Change") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## All compartments (global model)

```{r ancombc-all}
ps_ancom <- physeq_filtered %>%
  subset_samples(Broad_Compartment %in% merged_compartments) %>%
  tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ps_ancom <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ancom) > 0, ps_ancom)

tax_ancom <- add_genus_labels(ps_ancom)

sample_data(ps_ancom)$Broad_Compartment <- relevel(
  factor(sample_data(ps_ancom)$Broad_Compartment),
  ref = "Bulk_Soil"
)

ancom_res <- ancombc2(
  data = ps_ancom,
  fix_formula = "Broad_Compartment",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  alpha = 0.05,
  group = "Broad_Compartment",
  global = TRUE
)

ancom_df <- ancom_res$res %>%
  left_join(tax_ancom %>% select(taxon, Phylum, Family, Genus, Genus_label), by = "taxon")

cols_rh   <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_df, "Rhizosphere")
cols_endo <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_df, "Endosphere")
cols_ag   <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_df, "Aboveground")

sig_rh   <- ancom_df %>% filter(.data[[cols_rh$diff]] == TRUE)
sig_endo <- ancom_df %>% filter(.data[[cols_endo$diff]] == TRUE)
sig_ag   <- ancom_df %>% filter(.data[[cols_ag$diff]] == TRUE)

cat("Significant fungal genera vs Bulk_Soil:\n")
cat("  Rhizosphere:", nrow(sig_rh), "\n")
cat("  Endosphere:", nrow(sig_endo), "\n")
cat("  Aboveground:", nrow(sig_ag), "\n")
```

## Pairwise ANCOM-BC2 comparisons

### Rhizosphere vs Aboveground

```{r ancombc-rh-ag}
ps_rh_ag <- physeq_filtered %>%
  subset_samples(Broad_Compartment %in% c("Rhizosphere", "Aboveground")) %>%
  tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ps_rh_ag <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_rh_ag) > 0, ps_rh_ag)
sample_data(ps_rh_ag)$Broad_Compartment <- relevel(
  factor(sample_data(ps_rh_ag)$Broad_Compartment), ref = "Rhizosphere")

ancom_rh_ag <- ancombc2(data = ps_rh_ag, fix_formula = "Broad_Compartment",
                         p_adj_method = "BH", alpha = 0.05)

tax_rh_ag <- add_genus_labels(ps_rh_ag)
ancom_rh_ag_df <- ancom_rh_ag$res %>%
  left_join(tax_rh_ag %>% select(taxon, Phylum, Genus_label), by = "taxon")

cols_ra <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_rh_ag_df, "Aboveground")
```

```{r}
# ---- RHIZOSPHERE-CENTRIC ----
# Rh vs BS: already have (cols_rh from global model)
# Rh vs Endo: flip sign of Endo vs Rh
# Rh vs AG: need to run or flip sign of AG vs Rh

# Get taxa significant in at least one Rh comparison
sig_rh_all <- unique(c(sig_rh$taxon, sig_rh_endo$taxon, sig_rh_ag$taxon))

rh_centric <- ancom_df %>%
  filter(taxon %in% sig_rh_all) %>%
  rename(lfc_rh_vs_bs = all_of(cols_rh$lfc)) %>%
  left_join(
    ancom_rh_endo_df %>% 
      select(taxon, all_of(cols_re$lfc)) %>%
      rename(lfc_endo_vs_rh = all_of(cols_re$lfc)),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ancom_rh_ag_df %>%
      select(taxon, all_of(cols_ra$lfc)) %>%
      rename(lfc_ag_vs_rh = all_of(cols_ra$lfc)),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  # Flip signs so everything is FROM rhizosphere's perspective
  mutate(
    lfc_rh_vs_bs = lfc_rh_vs_bs,          # already Rh vs BS
    lfc_rh_vs_endo = -lfc_endo_vs_rh,     # flip: Rh vs Endo
    lfc_rh_vs_ag = -lfc_ag_vs_rh          # flip: Rh vs AG

  filter(!is.na(lfc_rh_vs_endo) | !is.na(lfc_rh_vs_ag)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("lfc_rh"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(mean_abs = (abs(lfc_rh_vs_bs) + abs(lfc_rh_vs_endo) + abs(lfc_rh_vs_ag)) / 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs)) %>%
  head(30) %>%
  mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(
    duplicated(Genus_label) | duplicated(Genus_label, fromLast = TRUE),
    paste0(Genus_label, " (", taxon, ")"),
    Genus_label
  ))

mat_rh <- rh_centric %>%
  select(Genus_label, lfc_rh_vs_bs, lfc_rh_vs_endo, lfc_rh_vs_ag) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genus_label") %>%
```

# Per-host ANCOM-BC2 heatmaps

```{r per-host-ancombc}
# Check sample sizes per host per compartment
host_compartments <- as(sample_data(physeq_filtered), "data.frame") %>%
  group_by(Host_species, Broad_Compartment) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Broad_Compartment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
print(host_compartments)

# Per-host ANCOM-BC2 function
run_host_ancom <- function(ps, host_name) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  keep <- rownames(sd)[sd$Host_species == host_name]
  ps_host <- prune_samples(keep, ps) %>%
    tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
  ps_host <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_host) > 0, ps_host)

  comp_counts <- table(sample_data(ps_host)$Broad_Compartment)
  comp_counts <- comp_counts[comp_counts >= 2]
  valid_comps <- names(comp_counts)

  if (length(valid_comps) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", host_name, "- fewer than 2 valid compartments\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  sd2 <- as(sample_data(ps_host), "data.frame")
  keep2 <- rownames(sd2)[sd2$Broad_Compartment %in% valid_comps]
  ps_host <- prune_samples(keep2, ps_host)
  ps_host <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_host) > 0, ps_host)

  ref <- ifelse("Bulk_Soil" %in% valid_comps, "Bulk_Soil", valid_comps[1])
  sample_data(ps_host)$Broad_Compartment <- relevel(
    factor(sample_data(ps_host)$Broad_Compartment), ref = ref
  )

  tax_df <- add_genus_labels(ps_host)

  res <- tryCatch(
    ancombc2(data = ps_host, fix_formula = "Broad_Compartment",
             p_adj_method = "BH", alpha = 0.05),
    error = function(e) { cat("Error for", host_name, ":", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )

  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  df <- res$res %>%
    left_join(tax_df %>% select(taxon, Phylum, Genus_label), by = "taxon")

  list(df = df, ref = ref, comps = valid_comps, host = host_name)
}

hosts <- c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium", "Racomitrium",
           "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus")
host_ancom_results <- lapply(hosts, function(h) run_host_ancom(physeq_filtered, h))
names(host_ancom_results) <- hosts
host_ancom_results <- host_ancom_results[!sapply(host_ancom_results, is.null)]
```

### Per-host heatmaps

```{r per-host-heatmaps, fig.height=10}
make_host_heatmap <- function(res, n_top = 30) {
  df <- res$df
  ref <- res$ref
  comps <- setdiff(res$comps, ref)
  host <- res$host

  lfc_cols <- sapply(comps, function(comp) {
    grep(paste0("^lfc_.*", comp, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  })
  diff_cols <- sapply(comps, function(comp) {
    col <- grep(paste0("^diff_.*", comp, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
    col[!grepl("robust", col)]
  })

  sig_filter <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(diff_cols, function(dc) df[[dc]] == TRUE))
  df_sig <- df[sig_filter, ]

  if (nrow(df_sig) == 0) {
    cat("No significant taxa for", host, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  mat <- df_sig %>%
    select(Genus_label, all_of(unname(lfc_cols))) %>%
    mutate(mean_abs = rowMeans(abs(across(-Genus_label)))) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abs)) %>%
    head(n_top) %>%
    select(-mean_abs) %>%
    mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(
      duplicated(Genus_label) | duplicated(Genus_label, fromLast = TRUE),
      paste0(Genus_label, " (", row_number(), ")"),
      Genus_label
    ))
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
  rownames(mat) <- NULL
  mat <- mat %>%
    column_to_rownames("Genus_label") %>%
    as.matrix()

  colnames(mat) <- gsub("lfc_Broad_Compartment", "", colnames(mat))
  colnames(mat) <- paste0(colnames(mat), "\nvs ", ref)

  pheatmap(mat,
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           fontsize_row = 8,
           main = paste0("ANCOM-BC2 (ITS): ", host, " — Significant Genera Along Gradient"),
           color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
           border_color = NA,
           display_numbers = TRUE,
           number_format = "%.1f",
           fontsize_number = 7)
}

for (h in names(host_ancom_results)) {
  make_host_heatmap(host_ancom_results[[h]])
}
```

# Indicator species analysis

```{r indicator-species}
ps_indic <- physeq_filtered %>%
  tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_data(.)$Broad_Compartment %in% merged_compartments, .)
ps_indic <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_indic) > 0, ps_indic)

otu_indic <- as(otu_table(ps_indic), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_indic)) otu_indic <- t(otu_indic)
otu_indic <- t(otu_indic)

groups <- as.character(sample_data(ps_indic)$Broad_Compartment)

set.seed(42)
indval_res <- multipatt(otu_indic, groups, func = "IndVal.g",
                        control = how(nperm = 999))

indval_summary <- indval_res$sign
indval_sig <- indval_summary[indval_summary$p.value < 0.05, ]

tax_indic <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_indic))
indval_sig$OTU <- rownames(indval_sig)
indval_sig <- indval_sig %>%
  left_join(tax_indic %>% rownames_to_column("OTU") %>%
              select(OTU, Phylum, Family, Genus), by = "OTU") %>%
  mutate(Genus_label = case_when(
    !is.na(Genus) & Genus != "" &
      !grepl("uncultured|unidentified", Genus, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ Genus,
    !is.na(Family) & Family != "" &
      !grepl("uncultured|unidentified", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ paste0("Unc.", Family),
    TRUE ~ "Unc."
  ))

cat("Significant fungal indicator genera:", nrow(indval_sig), "\n\n")

for (comp in merged_compartments) {
  col_name <- paste0("s.", comp)
  if (col_name %in% names(indval_sig)) {
    sub <- indval_sig %>% filter(.data[[col_name]] == 1) %>% arrange(p.value) %>% head(20)
    if (nrow(sub) > 0) {
      cat("--- Top fungal indicators for", comp, "---\n")
      print(sub[, c("Genus_label", "Phylum", "stat", "p.value")])
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r funguild}
    paste0("f__", row["Family"]),
    paste0("g__", row["Genus"]),

  )
})
```

```{r funguild-analysis}
guilds <- read_tsv("ITS/funguild_input.guilds.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~gsub("[ #]", "_", .x)) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

tax_df_fg <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_filtered)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("otu_id")

merged_tax <- left_join(tax_df_fg, guilds, by = "otu_id") %>%
  mutate(
    guild = ifelse(is.na(guild), "Unknown", guild),
    trophic_mode = ifelse(is.na(trophic_mode), "Unknown", trophic_mode),
    confidence_ranking = ifelse(is.na(confidence_ranking), "Unknown", confidence_ranking)
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("otu_id")

phy_guild <- physeq_filtered
tax_table(phy_guild) <- tax_table(as.matrix(merged_tax))

phy_guild_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phy_guild, function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

guild_df <- psmelt(phy_guild_rel) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment) & guild != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, guild) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

top_guilds <- guild_df %>%
  group_by(guild) %>%
  summarize(Total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(guild)

guild_plot_df <- guild_df %>%
  mutate(Guild_grouped = ifelse(guild %in% top_guilds, guild, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, Guild_grouped) %>%
  summarize(RelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(guild_plot_df, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Guild_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(title = "Fungal Guild Distribution Along the Gradient",
       y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "", fill = "Guild") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

# Trophic mode summary
trophic_df <- psmelt(phy_guild_rel) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment) & trophic_mode != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, trophic_mode) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(trophic_df, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = trophic_mode)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(title = "Fungal Trophic Mode Along the Gradient",
       y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "", fill = "Trophic Mode") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# Guild by host species
guild_host_df <- psmelt(phy_guild_rel) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment) & guild != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(Guild_grouped = ifelse(guild %in% top_guilds, guild, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Host_species, Broad_Compartment, Guild_grouped) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Host_species, Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(guild_host_df, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Guild_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +

  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
```

# Per-plant gradient profiles

## Phylum level

```{r per-plant-phylum, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
plants_with_gradient <- c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium",
                          "Racomitrium", "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus")

plant_plots <- lapply(plants_with_gradient, function(sp) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(physeq_filtered), "data.frame")
  keep <- rownames(sd)[sd$Host_species == sp]
  sub <- prune_samples(keep, physeq_filtered) %>%
    tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)
  df <- psmelt(sub) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment)) %>%
    group_by(Broad_Compartment, Phylum) %>%
    summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
    mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Phylum)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_pal) +
    labs(title = sp, y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
})

wrap_plots(plant_plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Fungal Phylum Composition Along Gradient — Per Host") &
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
```

## Genus level

```{r per-plant-genus, fig.height=18, fig.width=12}
genus_gradient_plots <- lapply(plants_with_gradient, function(sp) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(physeq_filtered), "data.frame")
  keep <- rownames(sd)[sd$Host_species == sp]
  sub <- prune_samples(keep, physeq_filtered)
  sub_genus <- tax_glom(sub, "Genus", NArm = FALSE) %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))
  top15 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(sub_genus), decreasing = TRUE))[1:15]
  sub_top <- prune_taxa(top15, sub_genus)
  tax_sub <- as.data.frame(tax_table(sub_top))
  tax_sub$label <- ifelse(is.na(tax_sub$Genus) | tax_sub$Genus == "" |
                           grepl("uncultured|unidentified", tax_sub$Genus, ignore.case = TRUE),
                          paste0("Unc.", tax_sub$Family), tax_sub$Genus)
  df <- psmelt(sub_top) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment)) %>%
    mutate(Genus_label = tax_sub$label[match(OTU, rownames(tax_sub))]) %>%
    group_by(Broad_Compartment, Genus_label) %>%
    summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
    mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Genus_label)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    labs(title = sp, y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "", fill = "Genus") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
})

wrap_plots(genus_gradient_plots, ncol = 1)
```

## Heatmaps guild per compartment

```{r}
# Heatmap — guilds × compartment (z-score scaled)
guild_heatmap <- psmelt(phy_guild_rel) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment) & guild != "Unknown" & guild %in% top_guilds) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / Total * 100) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, guild) %>%
  summarize(MeanRel = mean(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Broad_Compartment, values_from = MeanRel) %>%
  column_to_rownames("guild") %>%
  as.matrix()

pheatmap(guild_heatmap,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         fontsize_row = 9,
         main = "FUNGuild: Functional Guild Profiles Along the Gradient",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         border_color = NA,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.1f",
         fontsize_number = 8)
```

## heatmaps per host per compartment

```{r}
# Heatmap — guilds × host × compartment (z-score scaled, pheatmap with annotations)
guild_host_heatmap_data <- psmelt(phy_guild_rel) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment) & guild != "Unknown" & guild %in% top_guilds) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Host_species, Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / Total * 100) %>%
  group_by(Host_species, Broad_Compartment, guild) %>%
  summarize(MeanRel = mean(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop")

guild_host_mat <- guild_host_heatmap_data %>%
  unite("Host_Comp", Host_species, Broad_Compartment, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Host_Comp, values_from = MeanRel, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("guild") %>%
  as.matrix()

ann_col_guild <- data.frame(
  Host = gsub("_Bulk_Soil|_Rhizosphere|_Endosphere|_Aboveground", "", colnames(guild_host_mat)),
  Compartment = gsub(".*_(?=Bulk_Soil|Rhizosphere|Endosphere|Aboveground)", "",
                     colnames(guild_host_mat), perl = TRUE),
  row.names = colnames(guild_host_mat)
)

col_order_guild <- rownames(ann_col_guild)[order(ann_col_guild$Host,
  factor(ann_col_guild$Compartment, levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere", "Aboveground")))]
guild_host_mat <- guild_host_mat[, col_order_guild]
ann_col_guild <- ann_col_guild[col_order_guild, ]

host_gaps_guild <- cumsum(table(ann_col_guild$Host))

ITS_FUNGuild_gradient<-pheatmap(guild_host_mat,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         annotation_col = ann_col_guild,
         annotation_colors = list(Compartment = compartment_pal, Host = host_pal),
         gaps_col = host_gaps_guild,
         fontsize_row = 8,
         fontsize_col = 6,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "FUNGuild: Functional Guilds — Host × Compartment",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         border_color = NA)

ggsave("ITS_figures/ITS_FUNGuild_gradient.pdf", ITS_FUNGuild_gradient, width = 10, height = 8)

```

# Recruitment gradient — Ordination

## Vascular plants

```{r}
ps_gradient <- subset_samples(physeq_filtered,
  Host_species %in% c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium", "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus") &
  Broad_Compartment %in% c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere"))
ps_gradient_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_gradient, function(x) x / sum(x))

ord_grad <- ordinate(ps_gradient_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

plot_ordination(ps_gradient_rel, ord_grad,
                color = "Broad_Compartment", shape = "Host_species") +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Broad_Compartment), type = "norm", linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Fungal Recruitment Gradient — Vascular Plants",
       subtitle = "Bulk Soil → Rhizosphere → Endosphere")
```

# Endopshere diversity

```{r}
# Subset to endosphere only
ps_endo <- subset_samples(physeq_rare, Broad_Compartment == "Endosphere")
ps_endo <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_endo) > 0, ps_endo)

table(sample_data(ps_endo)$Host_species)

alpha_endo <- estimate_richness(ps_endo, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed", "Chao1"))
alpha_endo$Sample <- rownames(alpha_endo)
alpha_endo <- cbind(alpha_endo, as(sample_data(ps_endo), "data.frame"))

e1 <- ggplot(alpha_endo, aes(x = Host_species, y = Shannon, fill = Host_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_pal) +
  labs(title = "Endosphere Fungal Shannon Diversity by Host", x = "", y = "Shannon Index") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

e2 <- ggplot(alpha_endo, aes(x = Host_species, y = Observed, fill = Host_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_pal) +
  labs(title = "Endosphere Fungal ASV Richness by Host", x = "", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

e1 + e2

kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Host_species, data = alpha_endo)
kruskal.test(Observed ~ Host_species, data = alpha_endo)
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_endo$Shannon, alpha_endo$Host_species, p.adjust.method = "BH")
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_endo$Observed, alpha_endo$Host_species, p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

# Run MaAsLin 3

```{r}
library(maaslin3)

ps_maaslin <- suppressMessages(
  physeq_filtered %>%
    tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
)
ps_maaslin <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_maaslin) > 0, ps_maaslin)

# Build genus labels
tax_maas <- add_genus_labels(ps_maaslin)
label_vec <- tax_maas$Genus_label
dupes <- duplicated(label_vec) | duplicated(label_vec, fromLast = TRUE)
label_vec[dupes] <- paste0(label_vec[dupes], "_", seq_along(label_vec)[dupes])
names(label_vec) <- tax_maas$taxon

otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_maaslin), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_maaslin)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_mat)

colnames(otu_df) <- label_vec[colnames(otu_df)]

meta_maas <- as(sample_data(ps_maaslin), "data.frame")
meta_maas$Broad_Compartment <- factor(meta_maas$Broad_Compartment,
  levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere", "Aboveground"))
meta_maas$Host_species <- factor(meta_maas$Host_species,
  levels = c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium", "Racomitrium", "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus"))

maaslin_res <- maaslin3(
  input_data = otu_df,
  input_metadata = meta_maas,
  output = "ITS/maaslin3_output",
  fixed_effects = c("Broad_Compartment", "Host_species"),
  reference = c("Broad_Compartment,Bulk_Soil", "Host_species,Espeletia"),
  normalization = "TSS",
  transform = "LOG",
  min_prevalence = 0.1,
  cores = 4
)
```
